meta.name: Tech Persistence
meta.longDescription: Use Tech Persistence to run planning, work, review, compound learning, instinct evolution, risk-adaptive testing, context handoff, and Obsidian-compatible knowledge capture directly inside Codex.

catalog.name: Agent Loop
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /agent-loop command. v7 双原生控制面：Tech Persistence 单 owner 编排，Claude Code 产出/复审，Codex 实现；带 capability routing、验收 envelope 与 Goal lease

catalog.name: Compound
catalog.description: Codex-native evidence-gated knowledge compounding with bounded solution indexing and explicit write boundaries.

catalog.name: Memory
catalog.description: Codex on-demand memory retrieval and explicit durable writes with deduplication, provenance, and lifecycle controls.

catalog.name: Review
catalog.description: Codex-native findings-first review with evidence, risk-based testing, and bounded parallel reviewers.

catalog.name: Sprint
catalog.description: Codex-native sprint state machine with phase-local loading and transactional recovery.

catalog.name: Work
catalog.description: Codex-native implementation workflow using TDD, risk-scaled verification, and shared-workspace collaboration.

catalog.name: Caveman
catalog.description: Codex opt-in compressed communication mode. Use only when the current user explicitly invokes $caveman or asks for terse, low-token output.

catalog.name: Caveman Commit
catalog.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", invokes /caveman-commit, or invokes Codex $caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

catalog.name: Caveman Compress
catalog.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman:compress <filepath>, Codex $caveman-compress <filepath>, or "compress memory file"

catalog.name: Caveman Help
catalog.description: One-shot Codex reference for explicit caveman modes. Does not activate or persist a mode.

catalog.name: Caveman Review
catalog.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", invokes /caveman-review, or invokes Codex $caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

catalog.name: Checkpoint
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /checkpoint command. 保存当前 sprint/任务状态到交接文件，为上下文重置做准备

catalog.name: Context Handoff
catalog.description: 当 /sprint 执行中上下文压力过大，或任务拆分超过 5 个 Task 时加载。提供上下文重置和交接文件方法论。

catalog.name: Continuous Learning
catalog.description: Codex on-demand learning workflow: retrieve relevant durable knowledge, verify experience, and persist it explicitly through Compound.

catalog.name: Evolve
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /evolve command. 将本能聚类为可审计的 skill、command、agent 或 rule 学习候选

catalog.name: Instinct Export
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /instinct-export command. 导出本能供团队成员或其他项目使用

catalog.name: Instinct Import
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /instinct-import command. 将他人分享的本能解析为待核验学习候选

catalog.name: Instinct Status
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /instinct-status command. 查看所有已学习的本能及其置信度状态

catalog.name: Learn
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /learn command. 从当前会话提取技术经验并提交可审计学习候选（/compound 的轻量版）

catalog.name: Plan
catalog.description: Codex-native risk-scaled architecture and implementation planning with explicit dependencies and verification.

catalog.name: Prototype
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /prototype command. 从原型截图中提取需求：假设驱动、纠偏式收敛，不做冗长问答

catalog.name: Prototype Workflow
catalog.description: Codex opt-in prototype convergence. 仅当用户显式调用 /prototype 或请求原型需求收敛时使用；参考截图、Figma 链接和设计实现不自动触发。

catalog.name: Review Learnings
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /review-learnings command. 回顾所有技术沉淀：经验 + 本能 + 观察，支持搜索、统计、裁剪

catalog.name: Self Learning
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /self-learning command. 用户行为驱动的可信自学习入口：采集、Episode、Candidate、TV、shadow 与人工治理

catalog.name: Session Summary
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /session-summary command. 生成当前会话的完整技术总结，并通过 /learn 提交学习候选

catalog.name: Skill
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /skill command. Skill 进化统一入口：diagnose/eval/improve/publish/auto/list

catalog.name: Skill Diagnose
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /skill-diagnose command. [alias → /skill diagnose] 诊断 skill 健康状况：使用信号分析、步骤热力图、纠正模式、本能差异、progressive disclosure

catalog.name: Skill Eval
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /skill-eval command. [alias → /skill eval] 用测试集验证 skill：A/B 对比当前版本和提案版本的通过率

catalog.name: Skill Improve
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /skill-improve command. [alias → /skill improve] 基于诊断结果为 skill 生成修改提案：合并/精简/吸收本能/拆分

catalog.name: Skill Publish
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /skill-publish command. [alias → /skill publish] 将已验证的 skill 改进提案发布为新版本，含备份、changelog、回滚能力

catalog.name: Test
catalog.description: Codex-compatible entry point for the former /test command. 根据代码变更的风险等级自动决定测试深度并执行：L0免测→L4全面测试

catalog.name: Test Strategy
catalog.description: Codex opt-in testing strategy. 仅当用户显式调用 /test、test-strategy 或请求独立测试方案时使用；普通实现和审查不自动加载。

catalog.name: Think
catalog.description: Codex-native product framing for scope, user value, and observable success criteria.

updates.title: 用户行为驱动 Agent 自学习框架 P0：可信证据、候选生命周期与发布门禁
updates.summary: 目标不是让 Agent 把每次用户输入直接记成永久规则，而是建立一个可审计的学习闭环：观察用户行为、 操作、纠正、批准和任务结果，形成候选经验；只有经过证据、反例、评测、shadow 和人工批准的内容， 才允许影响后续 Agent 执行。

updates.title: mattpocock/skills + Cognitive Skill Engine v2.2 对当前 Skill 自进化架构的借鉴评估
updates.summary: 当前 Tech Persistence（下称 TP）的 Skill 自进化不是一个已经闭环的“自动进化引擎”，而是一个 证据意识较强、关键安全边界正确、但当前 Codex 入口链首尚未接通、其余环节也只有局部确定性 支撑的半机械化工作流：

updates.title: ECC (Enterprise Claude Code) sibling-eval
updates.summary: 目标用户判定：同类（dev-tooling）。这是罕见情况——[[feedbacktargetusermismatchinvalidatesborrow]] 的失效过滤器不拦，机制借鉴相关性最高的一次 sibling-eval。但"同类"≠"同规模"：ECC 的 enterprise/multi-harness/team 驱动在 solo TP 多数失效（targetuser_fit 普遍 partial/mismatch）。

updates.title: obra/superpowers + garrytan/gstack 2026-06 更新评估 — 可借鉴项收敛到 token、安全、决策可见性、eval 隔离
updates.summary: 用户请求：研究 obra/superpowers 和 garrytan/gstack 最近一个月更新了哪些内容，以及哪些值得直接借鉴到当前 tech-persistence 架构里。

updates.title: Sibling-eval：Claude /goal × Codex /goal 原生命令 vs TP /sprint --goal（收窄到原生 goal 原语）
updates.summary: 用户问"结合 Claude Code 自带的 /goal 和 Codex 自带的 /goal，TP 当前架构的 /sprint --goal 需要改进哪里"。作用域严格收窄到两个 runtime 各自的原生 /goal 命令本身，排除 Claude Dynamic Workflows / /loop / cron / Routines / fan-out（那些不是 /goal）。对比对象是 TP /sprint --goal（纯 markdown 协议 MVP，无宿主进程，…

updates.title: Sibling-eval：BMAD-METHOD + SuperClaude_Framework vs tech-persistence
updates.summary: 两个被评项规模都远大于 solo 自用的 TP（BMAD 团队敏捷 AI 方法论 / SuperClaude Claude-Code-only 配置框架），但「高 stars ≠ 借鉴理由」。19 个候选经多 agent 对抗核验（refute-by-default，每条 verdict 带 file:line 代码锚定）后：0 borrow / 0 adapt / 2 backlog（YAGNI-gated）/ 17 reject。

updates.title: Sibling-eval：MoAI-ADK (modu-ai) vs tech-persistence
updates.summary: MoAI-ADK = SPEC-First 重量级生产级 agentic 编码 harness（Go 单二进制 CLI，38,700+ 行 / 38 包，24-28 agents + 47-52 skills，Plan→Run→Sync→PR 全生命周期 + DB 管理 + design pipeline + GLM tmux 多 LLM）。规模与定位远超 solo 自用、纯 markdown+jsonl 的 TP。

updates.title: phuryn/pm-skills PRD 技能/命令评估 — 0 直接借鉴（目标用户错配）+ 2 收敛进化 + 1 不实施 follow-up
updates.summary: 用户请求："--auto 对比下 https://github.dev/phuryn/pm-skills，主要是里面的 PRD 相关的技能和命令"。
